pure-announcement.rationale: It is a navigational index of Anthropic's research teams and recent post titles rather than a product launch, release note, or funding announcement, though it carries no argument of its own.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest concepts covers an Anthropic research-team directory; the overlap with the weak-to-strong notes is only through one linked post title.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The page's few factual claims (team names, post titles, dates) are trivially checkable against anthropic.com.

durability.rationale: The bulk of the note is a rolling 'latest posts' listing with dates that will have churned completely within months, leaving nothing that stays true.

actionability.rationale: A table of contents of team blurbs and post links changes nothing about how a reader would build or decide.

atomicity.rationale: There is no single core idea, only five team blurbs and a dozen one-line post teasers, none of which is substantive enough to stand alone as a concept.
